The '''Roving Eye observation droid''' was a popular type of [[Cam droid/Legends|Holocam droid]] around [[137 ABY]] – a recording device attached to a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] system. It was used by law enforcement agencies, corporations and even [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]], who used the Roving Eye droids to monitor the training of his disciples in the [[Temple of the Sith]].

==Characteristics==
It was designed to collect different kind of data, compile it, strip of any errors and transmit the polished packet of data to a secure location. Alternately it could be programmed to store the data for manual retrieval or deliver the data physically to a destined location. It could connect directly to a computer networks, security sensors and camera feeds and analyze the data for the information necessary.
